ledger.note: 21 July 1807: the Free City of Danzig is proclaimed. 'The Republic was officially proclaimed on 21 July 1807', 'according to the Franco-Prussian Treaty of Tilsit of 9 July 1807'; it 'consisted of the city of Danzig along with its rural surroundings' (478 km2, 64,234 people, census year not given). The page names Saxony and Prussia as guarantee powers; the region is a radius, not a surveyed line.

ledger.note: 1807: a French governor rules the city. 'the actual ruler of the city was the French governor General Jean Rapp' (Lefebvre held the title Duc de Danzig); the page dates the French capture to May 1807 and the handover of the city to the new state on 27 May, not the governor's term, so the month is the founding month.

wars.outcome: Russian forces besieged the French-held city from late January to 29 November 1813; the French garrison withdrew on 2 January 1814 and the Free City ended.
wars.note: The siege article itself was not opened (page budget); dates are the Free City page's. The earlier siege of 1807 (the French capture in May 1807) precedes the state.

certainty.note: The page gives an area (478 km2) and 'the city ... along with its rural surroundings', no boundary line; the outline is a researcher's radius.
